issuer.summary: Ethena has a public team, institutional counterparties, recurring attestations, broad third-party monitoring and a demonstrated response to the October 2025 stress event. Issuer risk is tempered by concentrated ENA governance and a mismatch between the voters who allocate protocol revenue and USDe holders who bear reserve risk.
issuer.summary_source: October 29 shared BM evidence and RiskAnalyst targeted report/rationale review; last full verification October 11. Issuer score and its original generation date are unchanged. Current fee-switch activation and independent offchain custody are not verified.
facts: The historical ENA fee-switch proposal replaced the earlier Reserve-Fund-first parameters. Its stated supply milestones are not proof of current activation.

The original published $4.847948164bn average used 340 September 30–October 14 observations despite an October 28 computation timestamp. The repaired source now reports insufficient_history with null average and milestone; a complete current 14-day window remains unavailable.
Current spot supply cannot replace the required average or establish governance activation; authoritative activation evidence remains outstanding.
The historical proposal vote recorded 17.786m votes from 88 voters and no opposition; one account exceeded quorum alone. This update is not a new governance or authority audit.
USDe and sUSDe holders do not vote in ENA governance solely by holding these assets.

October 29 05:59:28 UTC issuer reporting shows a $62.059527m Reserve Fund and 100.3806% coverage excluding / 101.7467% including it. These are dated issuer disclosures, not independently verified offchain custody or a new Reserve Fund adequacy assessment.
issuer.issuer_score_basis: Ethena has a public team, institutional partners, repeated attestations, mature external monitoring and a demonstrated response to the October 2025 stress event. The offset is concentrated ENA governance: a fee-switch vote replaced the earlier Reserve-Fund-first policy, USDe holders do not vote, and one voter could clear quorum alone. Current fee-switch milestone and activation are unverified: the published $4.847948164bn average uses 340 September 30–October 14 observations despite an October 28 computation timestamp. Spot supply cannot replace a current average or establish governance activation; threshold sourcing and authoritative governance state still require verification.
issuer.issuer_score_persistence: Recheck at fee-switch activation, a governance redesign or a material operational failure.
